newsitem.title: USA: Office Depot affirms commitment to merger.
newsitem.headline: Office Depot affirms commitment to merger.

text.p: Office Depot Inc on Thursday said it still thought its proposed merger with Staples Inc was in the best interests of its customers and shareholders, two weeks after regulators moved to block the deal.

On April 4, the U.S. Federal Trade Commission rejected the proposed $4.0 billion merger between the retail chains, saying it would lead to higher prices for office supplies. The companies are contesting the FTC's decision.
As part of that effort, Office Depot said a hearing on a preliminary injunction was set May 19-23 in the Federal District Court in Washington, with a decision expected by mid-June.
